Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL and from the state machines the graph records. Four of SecurityProxyFinder's six rows carry their original names in the metadata: <GetFromAssociationsToRemove>d__5, <GetFromAssociationsToAdd>d__6, <GetFromAssociationsToRemoveForCopy>d__15 and <GetFromAssociationsToAddForCopy>d__16, and SecureComObjectInstanceExtension's iterator is <GetConnectedGroupAddresses>d__9, SecurityGrpFlagService's is <AllConnectors>d__18.
Method.validator family: The security validators share two helpers: GetTargetSegment (the device's line/area main line or the backbone line main segment, depending on the validator) and CollectAssociationsToRemove (the projection through SecurityValidatorBase.DetermineAssociationToRemoveValidator, whose siblings are named MergeAssociationsToRemove).
Method.handler: SecurityImpactsHandler.ExecuteUnlinkOperations builds the UnlinkConnectorOperation and UnlinkGroupAddressFromBusInterfaceOperation, validates and executes them; GetBusInterfaceConnectors returns the distinct list; InvalidateGroupAddressStates invalidates every affected group address.
